title: The Odyssey

vibeProfile.oneLine: Odysseus fights monsters and the sea for ten years to get home.

summary: After the fall of Troy, the wily Odysseus spends ten years trying to sail home to Ithaca, his wife and his son, blown off course into a world of one-eyed giants, sirens, witches and the sea god's wrath. Homer's second epic is the original adventure and the original homecoming, a poem about cunning, endurance and the longing for home that has shaped storytelling ever since. Endlessly translated and retold, it remains thrilling nearly three thousand years on.
whyReadIt: The original adventure and the original homecoming. Monsters, cunning and the ache for home, three thousand years old and still gripping.

funFacts.text: Its structure, a long journey home full of trials, underlies countless stories ever since.
